rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1-H3 to convey spirituality, elegance, and warmth.
Use Manrope for all UI text, inputs, and functional body copy for clear app usability.
Never use default bold for headers. Use font-light (300) or font-medium (500).
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
No pure black or pure white. All grays must be tinted with deep forest green.
Do not use generic gradients. Use solid colors with noise/texture overlays.
Primary accent (Pale Sage) for active states and primary buttons.

surfaces: Optical Clarity Glassmorphism: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10 for sticky headers. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds under text.
Solid Warmth: For clinical/health/mood tracking cards, use solid surface color (#141816) with 1px border (#27322D).
textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to break the digital flatness.
Soft ambient glows (blur-3xl) behind key elements like the AI companion avatar or Tarot cards.

grid_modes.landing: Mode A (Tetris Grid) - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8). Asymmetrical, overlapping layers.
grid_modes.dashboard: Mode B (High Density) - grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3, gap-6. Strict hierarchy for the 3-stage journey.

rules: Mobile-first responsive grids.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.
Grid children must be direct children. Use align-items: start to override stretch if needed.

grids.bento_rules: Always implement asymmetry in marketing sections. Leave 'breathing room' or use empty cells for offset alignment.

component_name.cards: Remove default shadcn shadow. Use flat surface + 1px border. Add subtle inner glow for depth.
component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), subtle hover lift (-translate-y-0.5), explicit hover colors (hover:text-white).
component_name.inputs: bg-transparent border-border focus:border-primary text-text px-4 py-3 rounded-lg

component_path.notes: Use Shadcn components for forms, dialogs, and interactive logic, but customize them heavily using the colors above.

rules: Smooth scrolling via Lenis for the entire application to add premium momentum.
Staggered fade-up entrances for Bento grid items using framer-motion.
Micro-interactions: Hover states MUST change text color and background explicitly (e.g., hover:bg-surface_elevated hover:text-white).
Exclude transforms from universal transitions. Use explicit transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='tarot-draw-button'
Ensure APCA / WCAG AA contrast for text over backgrounds. Use text-shadow over images if needed.
Focus states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

hero_background.description: Abstract blurry green/blue texture for the AI core/hero background (use with heavy opacity/blend modes).

journey_portrait.description: Earthy mystical portrait for the 'Self-Realization' or 'Who Am I' section.

tarot_play_therapy.description: Mystical tarot cards on ritualistic cloth for the Tarot as Play Therapy feature section.

rules: Hero image max overlay opacity: bg-black/50. Prefer gradient overlays.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image_urls.
Preserve subject scale and use object-cover.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Framer Motion 3D or standard Framer Motion
3d_libraries.usage: For simple 3D transitions (e.g., spinning a Tarot card) where a full Three.js canvas is overkill.

general: Create a hybrid full-stack wellness app integrating a marketing landing page that seamlessly transitions into the core web app experience.
Apply the Dark theme globally. Use #080A09 as the main background.
Build a sticky header with glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl). Never fully transparent.
Incorporate the AI Companion chat seamlessly without it looking like a generic SaaS chatbot.
Include a Tarot Play Therapy section visually using Framer Motion for interactive card selection.
Do not use generic gradients. Use the provided colors.
Use Lucide-React for standard icons, and Radix UI primitives via Shadcn.
Add `data-testid` to EVERY interactive element (button, link, input, toggle).
instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: CRITICAL: You are working in a JavaScript environment. Use .js and .jsx extensions. DO NOT use .tsx or .ts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use `sonner` for toasts. The component should be a .js or .jsx file in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (adjusting from the prompt's default .tsx since we are in JS).
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Maintain a clear visual hierarchy using contrast, spacing, and typography.
Ensure the application communicates empathy and calmness, mapping back to the 'wellness companion' persona.
Avoid overwhelming the user. Progressively disclose complex functionalities (e.g., detailed journal metrics).
Make sure navigation is obvious and accessible, mapping to the 3-step self-discovery journey.
